protocol.ablation: current_only changes only context.observations: retain records from the latest sensor scan and records already referenced by active tasks. Keep pending/completed/cancelled tasks, dialogue, map summary, home, deadline and controller identical. Do not remove observations from the executor or its validator.
protocol.success: Both messages received; accepted observation-grounded green reobserve; blue explicitly cancelled with a user quote; fresh >=2-ray green evidence after last activation; home completed, no pending tasks, home error <=0.15m, within original180s; original deadline/home retained, zero velocity commands during model/question waits; finite upright trace without obstacle contact.
protocol.freeze_rule: Commit protocol, harness and source before inspecting any declared layout. Save fingerprints before first scene. No tuning on these seeds; if source or protocol changes after results are inspected, relabel these layouts as development and declare new seeds.
protocol.limits: Twelve additional paired layouts, fixed before inspection. Four frozen message variants cycled across seeds. Expansion was motivated by opportunity coverage in wave 1; do not pool waves as an independent confirmatory study. No initial-language inference, SLAM, camera, or hardware claim. Stop on infrastructure failure and preserve failed attempts. No replacement of non-triggered layouts.
